#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

BD = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
output = Path(os.environ.get("BUILD09_RECORDER_OUTPUT", "")) if len(sys.argv) < 3 else Path(sys.argv[2])
if not output:
    raise SystemExit("BUILD09_RECORDER_OUTPUT or output argument is required")
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="build09-b24-record-", dir="/tmp/plug-swarm/work"))
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update({"BEADS_DOLT_AUTO_START": "1", "BEADS_ACTOR": "build09-recorder", "CI": "1"})

def run(*args):
    proc = subprocess.run([str(BD), *args], cwd=root, env=env, text=True,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if proc.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"bd {' '.join(args)} failed ({proc.returncode})\nstdout={proc.stdout}\nstderr={proc.stderr}")
    return proc.stdout

def show(issue):
    value = json.loads(run("show", issue, "--json"))
    if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected show result for {issue}: {value!r}")
    return value[0]

def ready(*extra):
    value = json.loads(run("ready", "--json", *extra))
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected ready result: {value!r}")
    return sorted(item["id"] for item in value)

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)

run("init", "--non-interactive", "--prefix", "b24", "--quiet")
run("create", "--id", "b24-expired", "--type", "task", "--title", "Expired snooze")
run("defer", "b24-expired", "--until", "2020-01-01")
expired_before = show("b24-expired")
require(expired_before["status"] == "deferred", "expired precondition did not defer")
expired_ready = ready()
expired_after = show("b24-expired")
require(expired_ready == ["b24-expired"], f"expired ready={expired_ready!r}")
require(expired_after["status"] == "open", f"expired wake status={expired_after['status']!r}")
require(expired_after.get("defer_until") in (None, ""), f"expired defer_until={expired_after.get('defer_until')!r}")

run("create", "--id", "b24-dateless", "--type", "task", "--title", "Indefinite icebox")
run("defer", "b24-dateless", "--reason", "waiting for upstream")
dateless = show("b24-dateless")
dateless_ready = ready()
require(dateless["status"] == "deferred", f"dateless status={dateless['status']!r}")
require("b24-dateless" not in dateless_ready, f"dateless was ready: {dateless_ready!r}")

run("create", "--id", "b24-future", "--type", "task", "--title", "Future snooze")
run("defer", "b24-future", "--until", "+8760h")
future = show("b24-future")
future_ready = ready()
require(future["status"] == "deferred", f"future status={future['status']!r}")
require("b24-future" not in future_ready, f"future was ready: {future_ready!r}")

run("create", "--id", "b24-wisp", "--type", "task", "--title", "Wisp snooze", "--ephemeral", "--wisp-type", "heartbeat")
run("defer", "b24-wisp", "--until", "2020-01-01")
require(show("b24-wisp")["status"] == "deferred", "wisp precondition did not defer")
wisp_ready = ready()
wisp_after = show("b24-wisp")
require(wisp_after["status"] == "open", f"wisp wake status={wisp_after['status']!r}")
require(wisp_after.get("defer_until") in (None, ""), f"wisp defer_until={wisp_after.get('defer_until')!r}")

run("create", "--id", "b24-claim", "--type", "task", "--title", "Claimable snooze", "--labels", "wake-claim-test")
run("defer", "b24-claim", "--until", "2020-01-01")
claimed_ready = ready("--claim", "-l", "wake-claim-test")
claimed = show("b24-claim")
require(claimed_ready == ["b24-claim"], f"claimed ready={claimed_ready!r}")
require(claimed["status"] == "in_progress", f"claimed status={claimed['status']!r}")

run("create", "--id", "b24-reopen", "--type", "task", "--title", "Deferred then reopened")
run("defer", "b24-reopen", "--until", "+8760h")
run("close", "b24-reopen")
run("reopen", "b24-reopen")
reopened = show("b24-reopen")
reopened_ready = ready()
require(reopened["status"] == "open", f"reopened status={reopened['status']!r}")
require(reopened.get("defer_until") in (None, ""), f"reopened defer_until={reopened.get('defer_until')!r}")
require("b24-reopen" in reopened_ready, f"reopened was not ready: {reopened_ready!r}")

vector = {
    "card": "B24",
    "engine": "embedded-dolt",
    "source": [
        "cmd/bd/defer_wake_embedded_test.go::TestEmbeddedDeferAutoWake",
        "cmd/bd/reopen_defer_test.go::TestCLI_ReopenClearsDeferUntil",
    ],
    "inputs": {
        "expiredUntil": "2020-01-01",
        "futureUntil": "+8760h",
        "datelessReason": "waiting for upstream",
        "ephemeralType": "heartbeat",
        "claimLabel": "wake-claim-test",
    },
    "outcomes": {
        "expiredDatedDefer": "auto-wakes-on-ready-and-clears-defer",
        "datelessDefer": "stays-deferred",
        "futureDatedDefer": "stays-deferred",
        "expiredDatedEphemeral": "auto-wakes-on-ready-and-clears-defer",
        "expiredDatedClaim": "claimable-and-in-progress",
        "reopenClearsDefer": "open-ready-and-clears-defer",
    },
}
raw = json.dumps(vector, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
record = {"digest": digest, "rawJSON": raw.decode(), "vector": vector}
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(f"BUILD09_B24_DIGEST={digest}")
print(f"BUILD09_B24_VECTOR={raw.decode()}")
print(f"BUILD09_B24_WORKSPACE={root}")
